metric_definitions.network_arrival_delay_ms: Per-setpoint one-way delay: t_arrival_uav_proxy − t_send_gcs (ms). Used for miss_ratio_network / owd_miss@D ms.
metric_definitions.aoi_network_ms: Continuous Age of Information at 100 Hz: t_sample − t_generation of the latest setpoint whose proxy arrival ≤ t_sample. Grows between arrivals; used for miss_ratio_aoi_network / aoi_miss@D ms.
metric_definitions.miss_ratio_network: Share of setpoints with network_arrival_delay_ms > D.
metric_definitions.miss_ratio_aoi_network: Share of 100 Hz AoI samples with aoi_network_ms > D.

cell_ul_activity.note: PROXY ONLY — not per-TTI cell PRB occupancy. ul_rounds_per_s = Δulsch_rounds / window; grant_activity_proxy_pct = 100 * total_rounds_per_s / ul_slots_per_s_nominal (400/s from OAI band78 rfsim 2 UL slots / 5 ms). May exceed 100% under multi-UE FDMA in the same UL slot. last_nprb_* is sticky last-grant size from MAC dumps (do not sum across UEs). share_ul_nprb_pct is between-slice share of those samples, not capacity used.

prb.note: OAI gNB MAC dump (mac_log_level=info): dl_delta_share_pct = delta of UE downlink bytes (MAC TX at gNB, or dlsch_total_bytes when logged); ul_delta_share_pct = delta of UE uplink bytes (MAC RX at gNB / ulsch_total_bytes); share_ul_nprb_pct = UL NPRB between-slice share of last-grant dump samples (not cell occupancy); cell_ul_activity = absolute UL rounds/bytes proxies (still not per-TTI occupancy). Polarity: OAI MAC TX=DL, RX=UL (fixed 2026-10).
